senses.en: seeming to be real or true, but possibly not
senses.pattern: an apparent contradiction / apparent calm / an apparent lack of interest
senses.example: Her [[apparent]] confidence on stage hid the fact that her hands were shaking badly.
senses.example_zh: 她在台上那份表面上的自信，掩蓋了她雙手抖個不停的事實。
senses.note: 副詞 apparently 意為「看來、似乎」

senses.en: the land along the side of a river
senses.pattern: the river bank / on the opposite bank / along the banks of
senses.example: We spread a blanket on the grassy [[bank]] and watched ducks swimming down the river.
senses.example_zh: 我們在長滿青草的河岸上鋪了毯子，看鴨子順著河水游去。

senses.en: a stored supply kept for later use
senses.pattern: a blood bank / a food bank / a seed bank / a data bank
senses.example: The hospital's blood [[bank]] is running low, so doctors are urging healthy adults to donate.
senses.example_zh: 醫院血庫的存量偏低，因此醫師呼籲健康的成年人捐血。

senses.en: to rely on something happening
senses.pattern: bank on sb / bank on doing sth / don't bank on it
senses.example: Don't [[bank]] on good weather for the picnic; bring an umbrella just in case.
senses.example_zh: 別指望野餐那天會有好天氣，還是帶把傘以防萬一。
senses.note: 固定與 on 連用：bank on

gsat.sentence: Then, the tortoise carries the hare and swims to the opposite [[bank]] of the river.
Situated on both [[banks]] of the winding River Vltava, Prague is like one big open-air museum.

senses.en: in front of or in the presence of someone
senses.pattern: appear before a judge / speak before an audience / before one's eyes
senses.example: The young inventor had to explain her design [[before]] a panel of five judges.
senses.example_zh: 這位年輕的發明家必須在五位評審面前說明她的設計。

senses.en: more important than something else
senses.pattern: put A before B / come before everything else / put quality before quantity
senses.example: A good captain always puts the safety of the passengers [[before]] his own.
senses.example_zh: 好的船長總是把乘客的安全看得重於自己的安危。

gsat.sentence: As a shy boy afraid of making public appearances, Timmy dreads the thought of speaking [[before]] large audiences.

His vivid paintings brought the splendor of the extraordinary landscapes [[before]] the eyes of American people, thus setting the stage for the regions to be widely recognized and officially established as national parks.

senses.en: being the cause of or explanation for something
senses.pattern: the reason behind / the idea behind / the story behind / be behind the attack
senses.example: Scientists are still trying to find out what is [[behind]] the sudden drop in the bee population.
senses.example_zh: 科學家仍在設法查明蜜蜂數量驟減背後的原因。

senses.en: supporting a person, idea, or plan
senses.pattern: be right behind sb / get behind a plan / be fully behind
senses.example: Whatever you decide to study at university, remember that your family is fully [[behind]] you.
senses.example_zh: 不論你決定在大學念什麼，要記得家人都全力支持你。

gsat.sentence: The theory [[behind]] the questionnaire used in the Dognition test.
There is a story [[behind]] how it was first made.

senses.en: to defeat or do better than someone
senses.pattern: best an opponent / best a rival / be bested by
senses.example: After a tense final round, the young chess player [[bested]] a champion twice her age.
senses.example_zh: 經過緊張的最後一輪，這位年輕棋手擊敗了年紀大她一倍的冠軍。
senses.note: 過去式、過去分詞為 bested；較正式

senses.en: to start to have an unpleasant effect
senses.pattern: begin to bite / start to bite / bite hard
senses.example: When the higher electricity prices began to [[bite]], many small shops had to shorten their opening hours.
senses.example_zh: 電價上漲開始產生不良影響，許多小店只好縮短營業時間。

senses.en: a small quick meal; a small amount of food
senses.pattern: grab a bite / a bite to eat / have a quick bite
senses.example: We had only twenty minutes before the movie, so we grabbed a quick [[bite]] at a noodle stand.
senses.example_zh: 電影開演前只剩二十分鐘，所以我們在麵攤匆匆吃了簡單的一餐。
senses.note: bite-sized＝一口大小的

senses.en: a lucky chance that leads to success
senses.pattern: a big break / a lucky break / get one's big break
senses.example: The young singer got her big [[break]] when a famous director heard her perform at a small café.
senses.example_zh: 一位名導演在小咖啡館聽到這位年輕歌手演唱，她因此得到成名的大好機會。

senses.en: to tell someone news or make it public first
senses.pattern: break the news to sb / break a story / break it to sb gently
senses.example: The doctor sat down beside the family and gently [[broke]] the bad news to them.
senses.example_zh: 醫生在家屬身旁坐下，委婉地向他們透露這個壞消息。
senses.note: 消息傳開也可說 The news broke.

senses.en: to reduce the gap or difference between two groups
senses.pattern: bridge the gap / bridge the divide / bridge their differences
senses.example: The new program aims to [[bridge]] the gap between students in cities and those in remote villages.
senses.example_zh: 這項新計畫旨在縮小城市學生與偏遠村落學生之間的差距。

senses.en: the raised part of a ship where the captain works
senses.pattern: on the bridge / the ship's bridge / return to the bridge
senses.example: The captain stayed on the [[bridge]] all night, steering the ship safely through the storm.
senses.example_zh: 船長整夜守在駕駛台，駕著船平安穿越暴風雨。
senses.note: 另可指「鼻梁」：the bridge of the nose

gsat.sentence: “A fishing ship came towards us with nobody on the [[bridge]] and ran us down.

senses.en: used to show the amount of difference
senses.pattern: rise by 10% / win by two points / miss the bus by a minute
senses.example: Our team lost the final [[by]] only one point, which made the defeat even harder to accept.
senses.example_zh: 我們隊在決賽僅以一分之差落敗，這讓失敗更難以接受。

senses.en: according to a rule, standard, or unit
senses.pattern: by law / paid by the hour / judge sb by / sell sth by the kilo
senses.example: Part-time workers at the café are paid [[by]] the hour, so longer shifts mean more money.
senses.example_zh: 這家咖啡店的工讀生按照時數計薪，所以班排得越長，賺得越多。
senses.note: by the＋單位：by the hour／kilo

gsat.sentence: [[By]] its reputation or the test scores it requires for admission?

senses.en: a group of people who share the same opinion
senses.pattern: the rival camp / the opposing camp / be divided into two camps
senses.example: After the debate, even students in the rival [[camp]] admitted that her argument was convincing.
senses.example_zh: 辯論結束後，就連敵對陣營的學生也承認她的論點很有說服力。

senses.en: an upper limit on an amount
senses.pattern: a cap on spending / a price cap / put a cap on
senses.example: The school put a [[cap]] of thirty students on each class to keep lessons effective.
senses.example_zh: 學校為每班設下三十名學生的上限，以維持教學成效。

senses.en: to set an upper limit on something
senses.pattern: cap prices / cap the number of / be capped at
senses.example: To protect the island's coral reefs, the number of daily visitors is [[capped]] at five hundred.
senses.example_zh: 為了保護島上的珊瑚礁，每日遊客人數設有五百人的上限。
senses.note: snow-capped 山頂積雪的

senses.en: a group of people with shared interests or jobs
senses.pattern: academic circles / business circles / a circle of friends
senses.example: The young scientist's discovery quickly became well known in academic [[circles]] around the world.
senses.example_zh: 這位年輕科學家的發現很快就在全球學術界廣為人知。
senses.note: 指「…界」時常用複數 circles

senses.en: to move in a circle, especially in the air
senses.pattern: circle overhead / circle above the field / circle around
senses.example: An eagle [[circled]] high above the valley, searching for its next meal.
senses.example_zh: 一隻老鷹在山谷上空高高盤旋，尋找下一餐。
senses.note: 也可作及物：circle the airport

gsat.sentence: The fashion soon spread beyond the [[circle]] of the nobility to the middle classes, and tea became a popular drink at the London coffee houses where people met to do business and discuss events of the day.

senses.en: to search carefully for information or facts
senses.pattern: dig into the past / dig for information / dig deeper into
senses.example: The reporter spent months [[digging]] into the company's records to find out where the money had gone.
senses.example_zh: 那名記者花了好幾個月深入探究該公司的紀錄，想查出錢的去向。

senses.en: a place or project where archaeologists dig for remains
senses.pattern: an archaeological dig / go on a dig / a dig site
senses.example: During the summer, history students joined an archaeological [[dig]] and uncovered pottery from an ancient village.
senses.example_zh: 暑假期間，歷史系學生參加了一場考古挖掘，挖出古代村落的陶器。
senses.note: 另可指「挖苦的話」：take a dig at

senses.en: to be enough or good enough for a purpose
senses.pattern: will do / that will do / won't do
senses.example: We have no proper vase, but this empty glass jar will [[do]] for the flowers.
senses.example_zh: 我們沒有像樣的花瓶，不過這個空玻璃罐拿來插花就夠用了。
senses.note: make do with＝將就使用

gsat.sentence: Then the child has to make [[do]] with shoes that are too small.

senses.en: to change something dishonestly in order to deceive
senses.pattern: doctor the figures / doctor a photo / doctor the evidence / a doctored document
senses.example: Experts soon discovered that the photo had been [[doctored]] to make the crowd look much larger.
senses.example_zh: 專家很快就發現那張照片遭到竄改，好讓人群看起來多得多。
senses.note: doctored photo 變造過的照片

senses.en: the soft, fine feathers of a bird
senses.pattern: a down jacket / a down pillow / goose down / filled with down
senses.example: This sleeping bag is filled with goose [[down]], so it is light but very warm.
senses.example_zh: 這個睡袋裡填充的是鵝的羽絨，所以又輕又保暖。

senses.en: (of a computer system) not working
senses.pattern: the system is down / the server went down / the website is down
senses.example: The school's website was [[down]] all morning, so nobody could check the exam results.
senses.example_zh: 學校網站整個早上都當機，所以沒有人能查詢考試成績。

senses.en: sad or unhappy
senses.pattern: feel down / be a bit down / seem down
senses.example: Whenever Tina feels [[down]], she calls her grandmother, who always knows how to cheer her up.
senses.example_zh: 每當蒂娜情緒低落時，她就打電話給奶奶，奶奶總是知道怎麼逗她開心。
senses.note: 不放在名詞前

gsat.sentence: According to psychologist Dean Burnett, people feel [[down]] in January owing to post-holiday discontent, and the Blue Monday claim makes it seem like there are scientific reasons for this.

senses.en: to clean a wound and cover it with a bandage
senses.pattern: dress a wound / dress a cut / dress a burn
senses.example: The school nurse cleaned the cut on my knee and [[dressed]] it with a clean bandage.
senses.example_zh: 校護清洗我膝蓋上的傷口，並用乾淨的繃帶包紮起來。
senses.note: 名詞 dressing：敷料；沙拉醬

senses.en: clothes of a particular type or for an occasion
senses.pattern: formal dress / casual dress / traditional dress / a dress code
senses.example: Guests at the festival were invited to wear the traditional [[dress]] of their own countries.
senses.example_zh: 主辦單位邀請參加節慶的賓客穿上各自國家的傳統服裝。
senses.note: 此義不可數

gsat.sentence: Only 4 percent of employers said that casual [[dress]] has a negative impact on productivity.

senses.en: the soil in which plants grow
senses.pattern: a handful of earth / damp earth / cover sth with earth
senses.example: He dug a small hole, placed the seed inside, and covered it with loose [[earth]].
senses.example_zh: 他挖了一個小洞，把種子放進去，再用鬆軟的泥土蓋起來。
senses.note: 此義為不可數名詞

senses.en: the ground; land as opposed to sea or sky
senses.pattern: fall to earth / deep in the earth / the earth shook
senses.example: The [[earth]] shook for nearly a minute, and books fell off the shelves in every classroom.
senses.example_zh: 地面搖晃了將近一分鐘，每間教室的書都從書架上掉下來。
senses.note: on earth 用於疑問詞後表「究竟」

gsat.sentence: But Brahma thought neither would do because he believed humans would dig into the [[earth]] and climb every mountain, and eventually find it.
The gods suggested that they hide it deep in the [[earth]] or take it to the top of the highest mountain.

senses.en: always; continuously; increasingly
senses.pattern: ever-changing / ever-increasing / ever since / as popular as ever
senses.example: Teachers must keep learning to meet the [[ever]]-growing demands of the digital classroom.
senses.example_zh: 教師必須持續學習，才能因應數位教室不斷增加的要求。
senses.note: 常構成複合形容詞：ever-＋V-ing

gsat.sentence: By working collectively, the ants are able to improve the efficiency of their network and adapt to their [[ever]]-changing environment.
President Jefferson also opened the house for public tours, and it has remained open, except during wartime, [[ever]] since.

senses.en: (of a person or face) to become red
senses.pattern: flush with embarrassment / flush with anger / flush bright red
senses.example: Her face [[flushed]] with embarrassment when the teacher read her poem aloud to the whole class.
senses.example_zh: 老師當著全班的面朗讀她的詩時，她尷尬得臉紅了。
senses.note: 名詞 flush 指臉上的紅暈

senses.en: the line where warm and cold air masses meet
senses.pattern: a cold front / a warm front / a front moves in
senses.example: A cold [[front]] will arrive tonight, so temperatures may drop by ten degrees tomorrow morning.
senses.example_zh: 冷鋒面今晚報到，明天早上氣溫可能下降十度。

senses.en: a particular area of activity
senses.pattern: on the economic front / on the education front / on all fronts
senses.example: On the health [[front]], the report shows that teenagers are sleeping less than ever before.
senses.example_zh: 在健康方面，報告顯示青少年的睡眠時間比以往都少。
senses.note: 介系詞用 on：on the … front

senses.en: strange, odd, or hard to explain
senses.pattern: a funny smell / a funny noise / something funny going on
senses.example: There is a [[funny]] smell coming from the fridge; I think the milk has gone bad.
senses.example_zh: 冰箱傳出一股奇怪的味道，我想牛奶壞掉了。

senses.en: slightly ill or unwell
senses.pattern: feel funny / feel a bit funny / my stomach feels funny
senses.example: I felt a bit [[funny]] after the boat ride, so I sat down and drank some water.
senses.example_zh: 搭完船後我覺得有點不太舒服，所以坐下來喝了些水。
senses.note: 口語用法

senses.en: to stay in the air or over a place
senses.pattern: hang over the city / hang in the air / hang low
senses.example: A thick cloud of smoke [[hung]] over the town for days after the forest fire.
senses.example_zh: 森林大火過後，濃煙籠罩小鎮上空好幾天。
senses.note: 過去式、過去分詞為 hung

senses.en: the skill or knack of doing something
senses.pattern: get the hang of it / get the hang of driving / get the hang of things
senses.example: Skateboarding looks hard, but most beginners get the [[hang]] of it within a few weeks.
senses.example_zh: 滑板看起來很難，但大多數初學者幾週內就能抓到訣竅。
senses.note: 固定用於 get the hang of

senses.en: to lead or be in charge of a group
senses.pattern: head a team / head a committee / head a department / be headed by
senses.example: Dr. Lin was chosen to [[head]] the research team studying the new virus.
senses.example_zh: 林博士獲選率領研究這種新病毒的團隊。

senses.en: to go in a particular direction
senses.pattern: head for the exit / head home / head north / head back to
senses.example: As dark clouds gathered, the hikers decided to [[head]] back to the campsite at once.
senses.example_zh: 烏雲聚攏時，健行者決定立刻朝營地走回去。

senses.en: the person in charge of a group or organization
senses.pattern: head of state / head of the department / the head of the family
senses.example: The [[head]] of the research center announced a new scholarship for outstanding science students.
senses.example_zh: 研究中心的負責人宣布設立一項新獎學金，獎勵傑出的理科學生。

gsat.sentence: They have also rung in times of celebration and of mourning, announcing such events as royal weddings and coronations of kings, as well as funerals of [[heads]] of state.
In 1884, Carl Elsener, [[head]] of the Swiss knife manufacturer Victorinox, seized that opportunity with both hands, and designed a soldier’s knife that the army loved.

senses.en: the place where something lives, is found, or first began
senses.pattern: be home to / the home of jazz / the natural home of the panda
senses.example: The island is [[home]] to more than two hundred species of birds found nowhere else.
senses.example_zh: 這座島嶼是兩百多種別處看不到的鳥類的棲息地。
senses.note: be home to 的 home 前不加冠詞

senses.en: a place where people or animals are cared for
senses.pattern: a nursing home / a children's home / a home for the elderly
senses.example: After her fall, Grandma spent three months in a nursing [[home]], where nurses helped her learn to walk again.
senses.example_zh: 奶奶跌倒後在安養院住了三個月，那裡的護理師幫助她重新學走路。

gsat.sentence: But some mountain ranges of South America, Africa, and Indonesia are also [[home]] to glaciers and ice sheets.

senses.en: to stay in good condition or be enough for a time
senses.pattern: last long / last a lifetime / last sb a week / be built to last
senses.example: We packed only enough drinking water to [[last]] us three days on the mountain trail.
senses.example_zh: 我們帶的飲用水只夠我們在登山步道上用三天。
senses.note: last + 人 + 一段時間：夠某人用多久

senses.zh: 最不可能的；最不願意的
senses.en: least likely or least suitable
senses.pattern: the last person to do sth / the last thing I want / the last place I expected
senses.example: Shy and quiet, Amy is the [[last]] person you would expect to sing on stage.
senses.example_zh: 艾咪害羞又安靜，是你最不可能料到會上台唱歌的人。

gsat.sentence: Many might not even [[last]] that long!
Colored paint makes it sound better and [[last]] longer.

senses.en: the way someone or something is seen or regarded
senses.pattern: in a new light / in a positive light / see sth in a different light
senses.example: The documentary showed the shy scientist in a completely new [[light]], as a funny and warm father.
senses.example_zh: 這部紀錄片以全新的角度呈現這位害羞的科學家：一位風趣又溫暖的父親。
senses.note: 句型：in a … light

senses.en: small in amount or degree
senses.pattern: light traffic / light rain / a light meal
senses.example: Doctors suggest a [[light]] meal in the evening, since eating too much can disturb your sleep.
senses.example_zh: 醫生建議晚餐吃少量的食物就好，因為吃太多會干擾睡眠。

gsat.sentence: The traffic in the city was [[light]] today, so Jane got home earlier than usual.

senses.en: living; not dead
senses.pattern: live animals / live fish / live bait
senses.example: The market sells [[live]] chickens and fish, which shocks some tourists from big cities.
senses.example_zh: 那個市場販賣活的雞和魚，讓一些來自大城市的遊客很震驚。
senses.note: 形容詞讀作 /laɪv/；只用於名詞前

senses.en: performed or broadcast as it happens, not recorded
senses.pattern: a live concert / live music / a live broadcast
senses.example: The café near our school has [[live]] music every Friday night, performed by local student bands.
senses.example_zh: 我們學校附近的咖啡廳每週五晚上都有現場音樂演出，由本地學生樂團表演。
senses.note: 也作副詞：broadcast live 現場直播

senses.en: connected to a source of electricity
senses.pattern: a live wire / live cables / live electrical equipment
senses.example: Never touch a fallen power line after a typhoon, because the wire may still be [[live]].
senses.example_zh: 颱風過後千萬不要碰掉落的電線，因為電線可能還是通電的。

gsat.sentence: After testing these brands on five different groups of [[live]] bedbugs for two hours, the scientists saw that the foggers had little—if any—effect on the insects.

senses.en: extremely small; very detailed
senses.pattern: minute particles / a minute amount / minute details / in minute detail
senses.example: Even [[minute]] amounts of the chemical in drinking water can harm young children.
senses.example_zh: 飲用水中即使只含微小劑量的這種化學物質，也可能傷害幼兒。
senses.note: 讀作 /maɪˈnjut/，重音在後

senses.en: the official written record of a meeting
senses.pattern: take the minutes / the minutes of the meeting / approve the minutes
senses.example: As secretary of the science club, Mia takes the [[minutes]] of every meeting and emails them to members.
senses.example_zh: 身為科學社的文書，米亞負責寫每次開會的會議紀錄，再用電子郵件寄給社員。

senses.en: a citizen of a particular country
senses.pattern: a foreign national / a Japanese national / French nationals
senses.example: The embassy helped more than two hundred Japanese [[nationals]] leave the island before the storm arrived.
senses.example_zh: 大使館在暴風雨來襲前，協助兩百多名日本僑民離開該島。
senses.note: 常指居住在外國的某國公民

senses.en: to come closer to something in time or space
senses.pattern: be nearing completion / be nearing the end / near retirement age / as the deadline nears
senses.example: As the exam [[neared]], the library stayed crowded until closing time every night.
senses.example_zh: 隨著考試逼近，圖書館每晚都擠滿了人，直到閉館。

senses.en: almost happening or almost being something
senses.pattern: a near disaster / a near miss / in near darkness / a near impossibility
senses.example: The two planes came within meters of each other in a [[near]] disaster over the airport.
senses.example_zh: 兩架飛機在機場上空相距僅數公尺，差一點釀成災難。
senses.note: 只放在名詞前

gsat.sentence: After several years of physical suffering and [[near]] financial ruin from the medical costs, the couple began questioning the treatment after consulting with other patients in online support groups.

senses.en: a special ability to find or recognize something
senses.pattern: a nose for news / a nose for a bargain / have a good nose for business
senses.example: With her [[nose]] for a good story, the reporter was the first to notice the strange pattern.
senses.example_zh: 憑著發掘好故事的敏銳直覺，那位記者最先注意到這個奇怪的規律。
senses.note: 常用 have a nose for＋名詞

senses.en: the front part of a plane or vehicle
senses.pattern: the nose of the plane / the nose of the rocket / the plane's nose
senses.example: The pilot slowly lifted the [[nose]] of the plane, and it rose smoothly into the air.
senses.example_zh: 飛行員慢慢拉起機頭，飛機便平穩地升空。

senses.en: a piece of academic writing on a subject
senses.pattern: a term paper / a research paper / publish a paper
senses.example: Professor Lin's latest [[paper]] on sleep and memory was published in a leading medical journal.
senses.example_zh: 林教授關於睡眠與記憶的最新論文，發表在一份頂尖的醫學期刊上。

senses.en: official documents, especially ones proving identity
senses.pattern: identity papers / show one's papers / sign the papers
senses.example: The officer at the border asked the driver to show his [[papers]] before letting the truck pass.
senses.example_zh: 邊境的官員要求司機出示證件，才讓卡車通過。
senses.note: 此義恆用複數 papers

gsat.sentence: Writing term [[papers]] and giving oral reports are typical course requirements for college students.
I’m working on my history [[paper]].

senses.en: something unpleasant suffered in order to get something
senses.pattern: pay a heavy price / at any price / the price of fame / a small price to pay
senses.example: Constant lack of sleep is the [[price]] many students pay for staying up to play online games.
senses.example_zh: 長期睡眠不足是許多學生熬夜玩線上遊戲所付出的代價。

senses.en: to set the amount of money something costs
senses.pattern: be priced at / reasonably priced / competitively priced / be priced too high
senses.example: The handmade notebooks are [[priced]] at two hundred dollars each, which most students can afford.
senses.example_zh: 這些手工筆記本每本定價兩百元，大多數學生都買得起。

senses.en: the right to take part in deciding something
senses.pattern: have a say in sth / have no say / have the final say
senses.example: Students should have a [[say]] in choosing the destination of their own graduation trip.
senses.example_zh: 學生對於自己畢業旅行的地點應該有發言權。
senses.note: have the final say 有最後決定權

senses.en: used to give an example or a possible amount
senses.pattern: say, ten minutes / let's say / in, say, three years
senses.example: If you save, [[say]], fifty dollars a week, you can buy the guitar before summer vacation.
senses.example_zh: 如果你每週存一點錢，比方說五十元，暑假前就能買下那把吉他。
senses.note: 作插入語，前後常有逗號

senses.en: (of a place) to have enough seats for
senses.pattern: seat 500 people / seat up to eight / a hall that seats
senses.example: The new concert hall [[seats]] two thousand people and has excellent sound from every row.
senses.example_zh: 新的音樂廳可容納兩千人就座，而且每一排的音響效果都極佳。
senses.note: 主詞為場所或車輛，不用進行式

senses.en: an official position as a member of a council or board
senses.pattern: win a seat / lose a seat / a seat on the board
senses.example: After a close vote, Kevin won a [[seat]] on the student council for the coming year.
senses.example_zh: 經過票數接近的投票，凱文贏得下一學年學生會的一個席位。

senses.en: to strongly influence how something develops
senses.pattern: shape one's character / shape the future / shape public opinion / be shaped by
senses.example: The years she spent in a small fishing village [[shaped]] her view of nature.
senses.example_zh: 她在小漁村度過的歲月塑造了她的自然觀。

senses.en: the physical condition of someone or something
senses.pattern: in good shape / in bad shape / stay in shape / out of shape
senses.example: My grandfather stays in good [[shape]] by swimming for an hour every morning.
senses.example_zh: 我爺爺每天早上游泳一小時，保持良好的健康狀況。
senses.note: 此義為不可數名詞

gsat.sentence: Meanwhile, environmental influences seem to [[shape]] a person’s synesthesia. For example, the flavors people with taste-word synesthesia experience are usually childhood flavors, such as chocolate or strawberries.
More than one-third are in such bad [[shape]] that they could die within ten years.

senses.en: neat and stylish in appearance
senses.pattern: look smart / a smart suit / smart clothes / a smart restaurant
senses.example: He looked very [[smart]] in his new suit at his sister's wedding.
senses.example_zh: 他在姊姊的婚禮上穿著新西裝，看起來非常體面。
senses.note: 主要為英式用法

senses.en: to feel a sharp stinging pain or feel upset
senses.pattern: eyes smart / smart from the smoke / be smarting from a defeat
senses.example: Her eyes began to [[smart]] as soon as she started chopping the onions.
senses.example_zh: 她一開始切洋蔥，眼睛就感到刺痛。

senses.en: to move your hand gently over something
senses.pattern: stroke a cat / stroke sb's hair / stroke gently
senses.example: The little girl gently [[stroked]] the rabbit's ears until it fell asleep in her arms.
senses.example_zh: 小女孩輕輕撫摸兔子的耳朵，直到牠在她懷裡睡著。

senses.en: a single hit, or movement of a pen or brush
senses.pattern: brush strokes / a stroke of the pen / with one stroke
senses.example: With a few quick [[strokes]] of his brush, the painter turned a blank sheet into a mountain scene.
senses.example_zh: 畫家用畫筆快速揮了幾筆，就把一張白紙變成一幅山景。

senses.en: a sudden piece of luck or a clever idea
senses.pattern: a stroke of luck / a stroke of genius / a stroke of fortune
senses.example: By a [[stroke]] of luck, two tickets for the sold-out concert were returned just as we reached the box office.
senses.example_zh: 好運突然降臨：我們剛到售票口，正好有人退回兩張原本已售完的演唱會門票。
senses.note: a stroke of luck＝意外的好運

gsat.sentence: After that sow gives birth, find the fourth piglet with a mark on its brow and, with one [[stroke]] of your knife, slaughter it.

senses.en: to express a feeling or opinion in words
senses.pattern: voice concerns / voice an opinion / voice doubts / voice support
senses.example: Several parents [[voiced]] concerns about the heavy schoolbags their children carry every day.
senses.example_zh: 幾位家長對孩子每天背的沉重書包表達了憂慮。

senses.en: the right to express opinions and influence decisions
senses.pattern: have a voice in / give sb a voice / the voice of the people
senses.example: The principal believes that students should have a [[voice]] in deciding the school's dress code.
senses.example_zh: 校長認為，學生對於學校服裝規定的制定應該有發言權。

gsat.sentence: His art thoughtfully expressed the [[voices]] of people suffering from war.

quiz.stem: At the public hearing, many angry residents ______ strong opposition to the plan to build a waste treatment plant near the elementary school.
quiz.explain_zh: voice＝表達（意見）。居民在公聽會上表達對興建廢棄物處理廠的強烈反對。

quiz.stem: Under a powerful microscope, even ______ cracks in the metal, far too small to be seen with the naked eye, become clearly visible.
quiz.explain_zh: minute＝微小的。在高倍顯微鏡下，肉眼看不見的微小裂縫也清晰可見。

quiz.stem: The proposal to start school an hour later has divided teachers into two ______: those who support it and those who fear a longer day.
quiz.explain_zh: camp＝陣營、派別。延後一小時上課的提案讓老師分成支持與反對兩個陣營。

quiz.stem: Many residents were angry that they had no ______ in the decision to cut down the old trees along their street.
quiz.explain_zh: say＝發言權。居民氣憤自己對砍除路樹的決定毫無置喙餘地。

quiz.stem: After spending a week volunteering at a nursing home, Kevin began to see his own grandparents in a new ______ and visited them more often.
quiz.explain_zh: light＝（看待事物的）角度。凱文到安養院當志工後，對自己的祖父母有了新的看法。

quiz.stem: The school's new auditorium can ______ up to eight hundred people, so the entire student body is able to attend assemblies together.
quiz.explain_zh: seat＝可容納…人就座。新禮堂坐得下八百人，全校可一起集會。

quiz.stem: The clerk lost his job after he was found ______ the receipts, changing several numbers so that he could keep some of the money.
quiz.explain_zh: doctor＝竄改。店員因竄改收據上的數字、私吞款項而丟了工作。

quiz.stem: It was a real ______ of luck that a doctor happened to be sitting next to the passenger who suddenly fainted on the plane.
quiz.explain_zh: stroke＝（好運的）突然降臨。昏倒的乘客旁邊剛好坐著醫生，真是意外的好運。

quiz.stem: The washing machine has been making a ______ noise since this morning, so Mom turned it off and called someone to repair it.
quiz.explain_zh: funny＝奇怪的。洗衣機從早上就一直發出怪聲，媽媽把它關掉並找人來修理。

quiz.stem: According to the latest report, the number of local students studying abroad has dropped ______ fifteen percent over the past two years.
quiz.explain_zh: by＝相差、以…的幅度。出國留學的學生人數兩年內減少了百分之十五。
